description:
Presented in excellent condition throughout, this spacious four-bedroom detached bungalow occupies a generous site of approximately 0.54 acres in a peaceful countryside setting just moments from the picturesque heritage village of Multyfarnham. Offering comfortable family living with endless potential, this attractive home combines generous accommodation with well-maintained gardens, while enjoying rural living and modern convenience, just off the N4 and only a short drive from Mullingar.

The accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall leading to a bright and spacious living room featuring a marble fireplace with cast iron inset solid fuel stove. An impressive open-plan kitchen and dining area, fitted with an extensive range of units and complemented by a large solid fuel stove. There are four well-proportioned bedrooms, all finished with laminate flooring, while the family bathroom is fitted with a modern suite including a fully tiled shower cubicle.

Externally, the property is surrounded by mature lawns offering excellent privacy and plenty of outdoor space for families to enjoy. A substantial detached garage provides valuable storage or workshop space, while the large side entrance and extensive driveway offer ample off-street parking.

Ideally positioned within walking distance of Multyfarnham Village, residents can enjoy an excellent range of local amenities including shops, cafés, pubs, schools, sporting facilities and two award-winning restaurants. The village is renowned for its strong sense of community, historic friary and beautiful natural surroundings. Ballinafid Lake and the crystal-clear waters of Lough Owel are just moments away, offering fishing, swimming, kayaking, boating and scenic lakeside walks, while Gaine Park, Abbey Blooms Botanical Gardens and a selection of heritage trails provide further recreational opportunities. Convenient access to the N4 ensures excellent connectivity to Mullingar, just 7km away, and beyond.

Offering spacious accommodation, a superb location and a generous site in one of Westmeath's most desirable villages, this is an outstanding opportunity to acquire a wonderful family home within Ireland's Hidden Heartlands. Viewing is highly recommended.
